say:1:1520449001:0.text: Sir Mage, did I hear you right? You're really going to provide food to the camp?
say:1:1520449001:0.source_cn: 魔法师大人，您刚刚说……要为营地提供食物？这是，这是真的吗？
say:1:1520449001:0.male: Sir Mage, did I hear you right? You're really going to provide food to the camp?
say:1:1520449001:0.female: Sir Mage, did I hear you right? You're really going to provide food to the camp?

say:2:1520449002:0.text: Don't get your hopes up too high. It's not any kind of delicacy.
say:2:1520449002:0.source_cn: 先说好，可不是什么珍馐美食。

say:3:1520449003:0.text: It's just needle locust meat. The Arcane Council will purify a supply and distribute it to you.
say:3:1520449003:0.source_cn: 只有针蝗肉，以后魔法师协会将定期准备一些可食用的虫肉分...

say:4:1520449004:0.text: That's already more than we could ever hope for. Thank you!
say:4:1520449004:0.source_cn: 这就足够了，我们不敢奢求太多——谢谢您，谢谢您！

say:6:1520449005:1.text: Mom, does that mean we get to eat meat again?
say:6:1520449005:1.source_cn: 妈妈，意思是说，以后我们还能吃到肉吗……？

say:7:1520449006:0.text: Yes, sweetheart. Thanks to these kind mages, we won't be hungry anymore.
say:7:1520449006:0.source_cn: 是的，孩子，是的……我们不用再挨饿了，多亏了这些好心的...

say:9:1520449007:1.text: Don't celebrate just yet. I'm not done.
say:9:1520449007:1.source_cn: 先别急着高兴，话还没说完呢。

say:10:1520449008:0.text: The Arcane Council will provide food, but only under one condition.
say:10:1520449008:0.source_cn: 魔法师协会可以为你们提供食物，但前提是——

say:11:1520449009:0.text: You must allow tracking magic to be placed on the camp, and you must promise not to speak of this to anyone outside.
say:11:1520449009:0.source_cn: 你们必须接受我的魔法追踪，并保证不会把这件事泄露出去。

say:15:1520449011:1.text: Why... why can't we tell others?
say:15:1520449011:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，我不明白……为什么不能告诉别人？

say:16:1520449012:1.text: Because that's the cost. Refuse, and the food stops. Think it over.
say:16:1520449012:1.source_cn: 这是必须的条件，如果你们不接受，我们也不会提供针蝗肉。...

say:17:1520449013:0.text: Why? If we can have a source of food, it could help more people survive—
say:17:1520449013:0.source_cn: ……为什么？如果可以有食物来源，就能让更多人填饱肚子——

say:18:1520449014:0.text: It's simple. The Arcane Council's power has limits. There isn't enough purified locust meat to feed everyone.
say:18:1520449014:0.source_cn: 很简单。魔法师协会的力量有极限。

say:19:1520449015:1.text: You'll become the target of resentment. Then the tragedy won't just be caused by natural disasters, but by human hands.
say:19:1520449015:1.source_cn: 净化的针蝗肉不够所有人吃，你们会被人嫉恨。到时酿成悲剧...

say:20:1520449016:0.text: That's all I'll say. Decide for yourselves.
say:20:1520449016:0.source_cn: 话放在这里。你们自己去想。

say:21:1520449017:0.text: We... need a moment to discuss.

say:25:1520449020:0.text: We've decided. We'll accept your conditions.
say:25:1520449020:0.source_cn: 魔法师大人，我们考虑好了……我们接受您的条件。

say:27:1520449022:0.text: Setting a tracking array's a pain. I'm dragging you two into it.
say:27:1520449022:0.source_cn: 追踪法阵布置起来很复杂，你们也过来帮忙。
say:27:1520449022:0.male: Setting a tracking array's a pain. I'm dragging you two into it.
say:27:1520449022:0.female: Setting a tracking array's a pain. I'm dragging you two into it.

choice_prompt:28:1520449022.female: Setting a tracking array's a pain. I'm dragging you two into it.

say:29:1520449023:0.text: Yep. Welcome to the glamorous life of forced, endless unpaid labor. Enjoy the perks.
say:29:1520449023:0.source_cn: 对，让你也体验一下被迫帮忙，不停打白工的感觉。

say:29:1520449023:0.female: Yep. Welcome to the glamorous life of forced, endless unpaid labor. Enjoy the perks.

say:31:1520449026:0.female: Morgan. *Sigh* <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Gala, I'm sorry. Please lend him a hand again.

say:33:1520449024:0.source_cn: 亡灵魔法很耗精力，不然你也来试试？

say:33:1520449024:0.female: You try doing necromancy and setting up arrays in the same day. I dare you.

choice:28:1:2.text: You need help even for this?
choice:28:1:2.male: You need help even for this?
choice:28:1:2.female: You need help even for this?

say:34:1520449025:0.text: No conspiracy here, you're just my favorite minion.
say:34:1520449025:0.male: No conspiracy here, you're just my favorite minion.
say:34:1520449025:0.female: No conspiracy here, you're just my favorite minion.

choice:28:2:3.source_cn: 你这么针对我，是不是别有所图？
